blogs.title: CyberGuard | Tech Sprint Experience
content: Recently, I presented my cybersecurity project CyberGuard at a Tech Sprint event.

Our team was scheduled in the last slot. We were officially given 5 minutes, but the presentation was stopped after only 1–2 minutes. Because of this, we could not fully explain the project architecture, features, and real-world use cases.

During the evaluation, the discussion focused only on one feature (phishing detection). Other important modules such as breach detection, DNS & SSL security, malware scanning, monitoring, and reporting were not reviewed.
## The judge also told us:
- "I am already aware of cyber fraud and take full care."
- The project is "only suitable for housewives."
This is where the concern arises.

CyberGuard is designed with a simple and user-friendly interface so that non-technical users can easily understand and use cybersecurity tools, while also offering advanced security features for students, professionals, businesses, and families. Cybersecurity tools are not built only for people who already feel secure; they are meant to protect everyone, as cyber fraud does not depend on awareness, profession, or gender. CyberGuard is an AI-powered cybersecurity platform built with multiple layers of security, not a single use case or a single type of user, and judging such a system based on only one feature, without giving a proper chance to explain, does not reflect the real value of the project.
## Team Members:
Sonam Yadav, Muskan Sharma, Vani Chandra
Respectfully thanking Dr Jyoti Upadhyay for the guidance, motivation, and support.

blogs.title: Anishow | Organic Growth & Performance Optimization
content: Really excited to share a recent milestone of my personal projects! 📈
Over the last 30 days, my anime streaming web project Anishow has experienced strong organic growth, which honestly feels very motivating as a student developer.
## 📊 Project Analytics (Last 30 Days):
- 🔹 Bounce Rate: 34%
This growth wasn't driven by ads — it came from continuous improvements in UI/UX, frontend performance, and SEO-focused content structure, all deployed and monitored using Vercel Analytics.
## While building Anishow, I worked deeply on:
- Designing a clean and user-friendly frontend
- Optimizing page speed and loading performance
- Structuring pages for better search visibility
- Understanding real user behavior through analytics
- Deploying and iterating fast using Vercel

This project has helped me move beyond "just coding" and start thinking more about users, performance, and scalability. Still learning every day, but moments like this really push me to build more and build better 🚀
I'm open to feedback, suggestions, and collaboration opportunities. Always happy to connect with fellow developers and learners!
